source: Open-Meteo ERA5 reanalysis forecasts versus NOAA GHCNh quality-screened hourly station summaries
issue_time_assumption: ERA5 values available through issue date minus 7 days; retrospective values may have been revised
station_limitations: Daily targets summarize quality-screened hourly readings. Mean is the mean of hourly medians; min/max are extrema of hourly medians, not true daily extrema. Require at least 18 distinct hours and 3 in every 6-hour block. ERA5 grid and station locations differ.
